verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Trivy is a CLI scanner designed for CI pipelines (trivy fs --scanners vuln,secret,misconfig) and community reports affirm it is 'super easy to integrate in every ci/cd pipeline' and used solely in CI to meet requirements, implying PR-scan-and-fail workflows are common. However, the pack lacks explicit documentation of exit-code flags (e.g. --exit-code) or GitHub Actions PR-gating examples that would confirm 'fail the build on new findings' behavior. missing for 10: explicit --exit-code/--severity gating docs, a documented GitHub Actions/PR workflow example, evidence of 'new findings only' diff behavior.
